commands: runningAsFunction() and log('Applied frontline engagement positioning updates!')
actions.name: frontline_engagement/recalculate

when: vars.frontline_engagement.camp.zone and any(vars.frontline_engagement.camp.zone, zone_id, zone_name, zone_search)
-- We'll only return to camp if we're within the configured range
commands: logf('[%s] Returning to camp location (%.1f, %.1f)', actionType, vars.frontline_engagement.camp.location.x, vars.frontline_engagement.camp.location.y)
comment: If we have an assigned camp location for this zone and we've moved too far from it, get back to it.

actions.comment: Ensure we face the enemy immediately.

comment: This gambit ensures that the leader engages trusts in the fight before
adhering to the configured engagement distance rules.

when: bt and aligned(bt, canAlign(bt) and vars.frontline_engagement.angle or nil, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement.tolerance, vars.frontline_engagement)
bt and (bt.center_distance or bt.distance) <= followDistance(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) + 2
not aligned(bt, canAlign(bt) and vars.frontline_engagement.angle or nil, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement.tolerance, vars.frontline_engagement)
commands: alignWithRetry(bt, canAlign(bt) and vars.frontline_engagement.angle or nil, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement, false) and setVar('frontline_engagement.arrived', true)
comment: Angle supports an exact number, frontside/backside/left/right/side, or a range such as 180+/-30.
A value of null allows alternate directions after a movement timeout.

actions.when: bt and (bt.center_distance or bt.distance) <= followDistance(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) + (vars.frontline_engagement.distance_priority and (vars.frontline_engagement.tolerance or 0.5) or 0) and following(bt)
actions.comment: Stop following and face the enemy if we're close to the mob.

actions.when: bt and (bt.center_distance or bt.distance) <= followDistance(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) + (vars.frontline_engagement.distance_priority and (vars.frontline_engagement.tolerance or 0.5) or 0) and not facingEnemy()
actions.comment: Keep facing the enemy as we fight.

actions.when: bt and (bt.center_distance or bt.distance) > followDistance(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) + (vars.frontline_engagement.distance_priority and (vars.frontline_engagement.tolerance or 0.5) or 0) and not following(bt)
actions.comment: Maintain a minimum distance from the enemy.

when: bt and (bt.center_distance or bt.distance) > (followDistance(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) + 2)
commands: not following(bt) and follow(bt, vars.frontline_engagement._distance, vars.frontline_engagement) and log('Unexpected: Initiated melee range following')
actions.comment: Ensure that we get into melee range without executing later actions.
